articles.title: Spain dominates the new FIFPro World XI with four players, without the Ballon d'Or
articles.standfirst: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the eleven best players of last season, with Harry Kane's absence standing out
articles.summary: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the eleven best players of last season, with Harry Kane's absence standing out
articles.body:
The Spanish National Team has been recognized for the World Cup won in the United States with the inclusion of four of its players in the FIFPro World XI . David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri Hernández and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the best eleven players of last season.

In the midst of a World Cup year , voters have had to choose from the last 26 finalists the 11 best players of the past campaign. The previous edition was dominated by PSG , with as many as five footballers from Luis Enrique’s team. This season, four Spaniards feature in the FIFPro World XI: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri Hernández and Lamine Yamal.

As in the previous season, there is still significant representation from the Parisian side, two-time Champions League winner , with Achraf Hakimi, Nuno Mendes and Vitinha.

On Real Madrid's side, the presence of Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé stands out. In a lineup in which the absence of the brand-new Ballon d'Or winner, Harry Kane , is striking, the other two spots are filled by Erling Haaland and Leo Messi .

Therefore, the FIFPro 2026 World XI is as follows: David Raya; Achraf Hakimi, Pau Cubarsí, Nuno Mendes; Rodri, Vitinha, Bellingham; Messi, Yamal, Mbappé and Haaland.

David Raya has been the player who has accumulated the most votes across all positions . 51.9% of the footballers chose the Arsenal goalkeeper as the best of last season, far ahead of the runner-up; Courtois (38.6%). Among the defenders, Pau Cubarsí, with 26.8%, was only surpassed by Hakimi (40.9%).

Among the midfielders , Rodri leads the list with 33.1% , closely followed by Bellingham ( 31.3% ). And in the forwards area, 46% of the voters chose Mbappé , and 37.4% chose Lamine Yamal . Behind them, Messi (29.5%) and Haaland (28.4%) left out Harry Kane (27.6%), in a lineup with four attackers .

An unprecedented situation

The absence of Bayern Munich 's " number nine " is something extraordinary . For the first time since this award began in 2005 , the winner of the Ballon d'Or that same year has not been included afterward in the ideal FIFPro team.

The voting was carried out by 19,806 footballers from 73 countries who assessed "their performances between 4 August 2025 and 19 July 2026 , both inclusive, during which they must have played at least 30 official matches".

With the four appearances in this new edition, Spain widens its lead as the country with the highest number of appearances in the Men's World XI , with 53 selections shared among 17 players . In addition, Lamine Yamal becomes the first player in history to appear for the second time in the FIFPro World XI before the age of 20.

articles.title: "We're going to take advantage of it": Araújo's provocative remark about Messi before Argentina-Uruguay that heats up the friendly
articles.standfirst: The Uruguayan defender, who shared a locker room with the former Argentine captain at Barcelona, anticipated how La Celeste will try to take advantage of the No. 10's absence and left a remark that fired up the buildup to the clásico at La Bombonera.
articles.summary: The Uruguayan defender, who shared a locker room with the former Argentine captain at Barcelona, anticipated how La Celeste will try to take advantage of the No. 10's absence and left a remark that fired up the buildup to the clásico at La Bombonera.
articles.body:
The Argentina national team will face a special test this Friday, November 13, when it hosts Uruguay at La Bombonera. It will be its first match after Lionel Messi 's farewell from the national team and, ahead of the game, people from La Celeste have already started heating up the Río de la Plata clásico with controversial statements.

One of those who spoke was Ronald Araújo, who knows the Argentine captain very well from having shared a dressing room with him at Barcelona. The Uruguayan defender did not avoid the subject of his absence and issued a warning that quickly drew attention: "In the end they lost the best player in the world, and we're going to take advantage of that."

Araújo's warning to the Argentina national team over Messi

The footballer made it clear that Uruguay will try to take advantage of the Albiceleste's new reality. However, he also acknowledged that Lionel Scaloni's team retains significant pedigree and that it will not be easy to face them. "They have great players, they have young players with a lot of quality, they are a great powerhouse", he said.

Araújo also highlighted the difficulty of facing Argentina and anticipated that Uruguay will seek to impose its style of play . "All matches against Argentina are difficult, but we are going to show our football and continue growing as a national team" added the defender, who is preparing for one of the most attractive matches of the FIFA international break.

Araújo will have a special duel with Alexis Mac Allister

The clásico will also have a particular twist for the Uruguayan defender: on the other side will be Alexis Mac Allister, his teammate at Liverpool. Araújo acknowledged that there had already been some joking between the two footballers ahead of the match. "We've already teased each other a little," he said, referring to the clash with his eyes on a duel that will have a special edge because it is Scaloni's first match without Messi.

The match will mark the beginning of a new era for the Argentine national team, which will have to face its commitments without the presence of its historic captain.

After the match against Uruguay, Scaloni's team will face Costa Rica on Tuesday, November 17, in Córdoba.

While Argentina will seek to show that it remains competitive without Messi, Uruguay will arrive hoping to take advantage of the new scenario.

articles.title: Shae Cruyff, Johan's grandson, called up by the United States
articles.standfirst: The legacy of the former Dutch player continues: he is an under-18 international
articles.summary: The legacy of the former Dutch player continues: he is an under-18 international
articles.body:
The surname Cruyff remains linked to the world of football. The legacy of the legendary former player and former coach, who passed away in 2016, lives on. Following the career of his son, Jordi, it is now his grandson Shea who is taking important steps in the sport: he has been called up to the United States under-18 national team.

Shea Cruyff-Beane, the youngest son of Chantal Cruyff, was called up in recent hours by the American national team, which will play two matches. Johan's grandson, who plays as a midfielder, is part of the youth ranks of Nàstic de Tarragona.

Shea holds three nationalities: Spain (where he was born), the Netherlands (his maternal family's country of origin), and the United States (his father's origin). He has now been called up by the American U18 team, but he could still change his national team in the future.

Football has always been a part of Shea 's life, since he is not only the grandson and nephew of professionals in this sport, but his father, Todd Beane, played for Dartmouth College, in the first division of the NCAA, and even went on to play professionally in his country.

The United States U18 team will face Portugal and Norway in the Lusitanian country.

articles.title: Pochettino accused of using USMNT “losers” to land Manchester United job: “He was just pretending”
articles.standfirst: Harsh article by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport against the United States national team coach
articles.summary: Harsh article by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport against the United States national team coach
articles.body:
The more than likely arrival of Mauricio Pochettino to the Manchester United bench, and the consequent breaking of the agreement the Argentine coach had with the United States national team until 2030, is one of the topics of the day.

Among all the published articles, the opinion column written this Wednesday by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport stands out, in which the author claims that "Mauricio Pochettino used the US national team's "losers""... to land his dream job".

Mauricio Pochettino told everyone who would listen that this moment would come. The big question for the United States men's national team is whether the U.S. Soccer Federation was smart enough to prepare for the inevitable , Brian T. Smith asks.

Pochettino's objective was always the Premier League

In the article, the author recalls that Pochettino always wanted what is about to happen: to return to the Premier League after the World Cup . "Now focused on the United States national team, perhaps one day I will return to the Premier League ," he said in a previous interview with TalkSport.

"The reality was that Pochettino fell frustratingly short with Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Chris Richards, Christian Pulisic and a group of talents that was supposed to be the best U.S. soccer had ever produced ," criticizes Smith, who believes that Pochettino's interest in developing U.S. soccer was fictitious , as the Federation promised after the renewal.

Manchester United is ready to pay the $10 million release clause in the coach's contract , which was in force until 2030 before becoming worthless paper.

A problem for USMNT: replacement sought

" Pochettino was only acting when he pretended to love the United States national team . Which team would you rather manage: Manchester United or the United States national team?", he quips.

"Until soccer becomes a major sport in the United States, the search for a head coach truly committed to the United States will always be the same ," the article predicts.

"The United States national soccer team will have been nothing more than a springboard to something bigger and better on a brighter stage ," Smith concludes.

articles.title: Soccer ball goes in the wrong direction as powerful winds wreak havoc during match in Japan
articles.summary: A remarkable clip from Japan's J2 League circulated on social media in November 2026, showing powerful winds dramatically altering a soccer ball's trajectory during a match. Shared by football account @fodboldworld on X, the footage captures a ball traveling forward before being blown back in the opposite direction, creating an unusual moment on the pitch.
articles.body:
A remarkable clip from Japan's J2 League circulated on social media in November 2026, showing powerful winds dramatically altering a soccer ball's trajectory during a match. Shared by football account @fodboldworld on X, the footage captures a ball traveling forward before being blown back in the opposite direction, creating an unusual moment on the pitch.

Japanese reports point to a November 7 match between Blaublitz Akita and Oita Trinita as a particularly striking example of these conditions. Strong winds in Akita significantly affected the ball's movement and made controlling passes difficult. Oita took the lead in the first half but struggled after switching ends, eventually losing 2–1.

articles.title: Video resurfaces showing prime Cristiano Ronaldo jumping higher than NBA players
articles.summary: A resurfaced video shared by Polymarket Sports on X has renewed attention on Cristiano Ronaldo's extraordinary jumping ability during the peak of his soccer career. The Portuguese superstar became famous for spectacular headers that appeared to defy gravity, prompting comparisons with professional NBA players. Biomechanical studies and footage analyses suggest that his vertical leap could match or exceed that of many basketball players, although comparisons depend on the measurement method.
articles.body:
A resurfaced video shared by Polymarket Sports on X has renewed attention on Cristiano Ronaldo's extraordinary jumping ability during the peak of his soccer career. The Portuguese superstar became famous for spectacular headers that appeared to defy gravity, prompting comparisons with professional NBA players. Biomechanical studies and footage analyses suggest that his vertical leap could match or exceed that of many basketball players, although comparisons depend on the measurement method.

One of Ronaldo's most famous jumps occurred on February 13, 2013, when he scored for Real Madrid against Manchester United in the Champions League. A computer-based analysis by Spanish television estimated that his head reached 2.93 meters, approximately 9 feet 7 inches, above the ground. That is only 12 centimeters below the height of a regulation basketball hoop. Importantly, this figure represents the height of his head, not the distance his body rose from the ground.

articles.title: Pep Guardiola emerges as shock USMNT target amid Manchester United domino effect
articles.standfirst: If Manchester United pulls the trigger on Pochettino, US Soccer is ready to swing for the absolute fences. Could Pep Guardiola really be heading to the USMNT?
articles.summary: If Manchester United pulls the trigger on Pochettino, US Soccer is ready to swing for the absolute fences. Could Pep Guardiola really be heading to the USMNT?
articles.body:
On the verge of beginning the quarterfinal round of the Concacaf Nations League , the United States national team is going through a turbulent moment, as its project toward 2030 could be altered.

Their coach Mauricio Pochettino , who was retained despite the poor results prior to the 2026 World Cup , where he was eliminated in the round of 16, is the main target of Manchester United to rebuild a season in which they are in the relegation zone after 10 matchdays with Michael Carrick in charge.

Pep Guardiola, an option for the United States?

In what appears to be an imminent departure of the Argentine manager to the Premier League , where he stood out with Tottenham , a name of global significance is already beginning to emerge.

According to information from The Athletic, “ US Soccer is expected to make Pep Guardiola a top target to replace Mauricio Pochettino if the men’s national team coach leaves for Manchester United,” reports the sports outlet of The New York Times.

This is not the first time that the U.S. federation has intended to be able to hire the former Manchester City coach, since it also had him on its list ahead of the 2022 Qatar World Cup , The Athletic adds.

Guardiola has shown interest in the United States

Guardiola, who lived in New York after leaving Barcelona in 2012 and before joining Bayern Munich in 2013, has shown interest in Team USA in the past.

“ The United States is fascinating for trying to build a project over many years and being able to take the national team to the next level . The potential of the United States is there, because of the large number of people and sports,” he said in 2024.

Team USA faces Haiti in the quarterfinals of the Concacaf Nations League next Saturday away in Jamaica, where the Mexican National Team will also play; the Haitians cannot play in their country due to the turbulent political situation, and they host the second leg on Tuesday in Cincinnati. These matches are expected to be managed by Pochettino, and then the search for the new head coach would begin.

Rafa Márquez could come up against his coach from Barcelona

If this supposed possibility were to materialize, Rafa Márquez could face Joseph Guardiola for the first time as a coach, and it would be in a Mexico vs United States . Both were together at FC Barcelona between 2008 and 2010, the first years as head coach of the first team for the former Dorados de Sinaloa player.

Although it looks complicated, due to the Catalan's desire to rest and because of the refusal he gave to Italy this very summer, U.S. Soccer is in no rush this year to appoint a coach, since after this FIFA window its next matches are not until March 2027, which gives them more time to convince a high-profile coach, among whom Guardiola should be, according to reports this Wednesday.

articles.title: Former Brazil star Adriano shows he's still got it while playing street soccer in a humble neighborhood
articles.summary: Former Brazilian international Adriano Leite Ribeiro, famously nicknamed The Emperor, has gone viral after footage showed him performing an impressive series of soccer tricks on a street in Brazil. The video circulated widely on November 10 and 11, 2026, reminding fans of the technical ability that once made him one of the world's most feared strikers.
articles.body:
Former Brazilian international Adriano Leite Ribeiro, famously nicknamed The Emperor, has gone viral after footage showed him performing an impressive series of soccer tricks on a street in Brazil. The video circulated widely on November 10 and 11, 2026, reminding fans of the technical ability that once made him one of the world's most feared strikers.

Appearing shirtless and wearing shorts and flip-flops, the 44-year-old former Inter Milan striker completed 32 consecutive touches without letting the ball hit the ground. His demonstration included balancing the ball on his head and moving it between his legs, attracting admiration from viewers who remembered his playing days.

Adriano enjoyed the peak of his career at Inter Milan, where he won domestic trophies and became famous for his powerful left foot. He also played a decisive role in Brazil's 2004 Copa América victory, finishing as the tournament's leading scorer with seven goals and scoring a late equalizer against Argentina in the final. His career was later affected by injuries and personal struggles, and he retired professionally in 2016.

articles.title: USMNT's dream is Pep Guardiola, but a coach linked to Cristiano Ronaldo could be chosen
articles.standfirst: Speculation continues about the new national team coach following Mauricio Pochettino's departure
articles.summary: Speculation continues about the new national team coach following Mauricio Pochettino's departure
articles.body:
Once Mauricio Pochettino 's signing by Manchester United has been officially confirmed, it remains to be seen who will be in charge of filling the position that the argentine coach will leave vacant at the helm of the United States national team .

"According to TalkSport, the United States Soccer Federation wants Pep Guardiola to replace Mauricio Pochettino," but the truth is that everything indicates that this possibility is unlikely to happen.

Pep Guardiola's intentions

The Spanish coach, formerly of Barcelona , Bayern , and Manchester City , is currently without a team and would be a top-level signing for U.S. soccer, but Guardiola's intentions seem clear: to rest.

"After my contract with City, I’m going to stop. I’m sure. I don’t know if I’m going to retire, but I’m going to take a break," he said more than a year ago when he was still in charge of the Citizens team.

There are also many doubts that the USMNT project is the one that could convince Guardiola to break his plans and return to coaching. Nor that he wants to manage a national team, after having developed his entire career in club football.

Roberto Martínez, a more realistic option

Another of the candidates already being mentioned for the position is Roberto Martínez , Cristiano Ronaldo's former coach with the Portugal national team during the last World Cup. The Spanish manager is currently without a team, but his profile could fit the role: he speaks English perfectly and has managed two top-level national teams such as Portugal and Belgium, in addition to having Premier League experience.

Another of the candidates already being mentioned for the position is Roberto Martínez , Cristiano Ronaldo's former coach with the Portugal national team during the last World Cup. The Spanish manager is currently without a team, but his profile could fit the role: he speaks English perfectly and has managed two top-level national teams such as Portugal and Belgium, in addition to having Premier League experience.

articles.title: Pochettino's farewell message to the USMNT: “It was one of the greatest honors of my career”
articles.standfirst: The Argentine manager has decided to bring his spell in charge of the U.S. national team to an end to take the reins at the helm at Old Trafford
articles.summary: The Argentine manager has decided to bring his spell in charge of the U.S. national team to an end to take the reins at the helm at Old Trafford
articles.body:
The football world has woken up to one of the biggest bombshells in international dugouts in recent times. Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a radical turn in his professional career by accepting the formal offer to become the new head coach of Manchester United, bringing his time in charge of the United States men's national soccer team to an early end (USMNT).

The news, which was confirmed simultaneously by various specialized outlets such as Infobae and El Universo, reveals th at the former Chelsea and Tottenham manager will assume his new duties at the English club starting next November 18 . This decision comes as a surprise to insiders and outsiders alike, given that the tactician had been leading the North American side's preparation process with the aim of consolidating an attacking identity for the future.

During his tenure at the helm of the U.S. national team, Pochettino managed to instill character and led the team to the Round of 16 of the FIFA World Cup , showing flashes of good football and a competitive structure. However, the call from the "Red Devils" — who were looking for a high-profile leader after Michael Carrick's departure — proved to be an opportunity the South American coach could not turn down.

The bittersweet farewell to the Stars and Stripes bench

According to reports issued by outlets such as RPP and the platform Tribuna, Pochettino’s departure will take place immediately once the current international break concludes . The United States Soccer Federation (USSF) agreed on the terms to release the coach and his entire coaching staff after the official fixtures scheduled against Haiti, which will be played on November 14 and 17.

Facing this imminent departure, the Argentine coach himself wanted to dedicate a few words of thanks to the fans and the American management, highlighting the pride that representing the country meant. In statements reported by the international press, Pochettino confessed with deep emotion: “It was one of the greatest honors of my career” , adding that his time with the national team and the affection he received will always hold a very special place in their hearts.

A new giant in the Premier League and the details of the deal

For its part, the iusport portal detailed the legal and operational terms of the Argentine's move to English football. Manchester United made official that the link will formally begin on November 18, once the strategist is fully released from his international responsibilities with the U.S. federation .

Pochettino arrives at Old Trafford backed by a solid track record in European football that includes notable spells with Espanyol of Barcelona, Southampton—where he broke historic points records—and five memorable seasons at Tottenham Hotspur, the club he led to the historic 2019 UEFA Champions League final. Likewise, his recent experience managing Paris Saint-Germain in France and Chelsea in the Premier League gives him the ideal credentials to set Manchester’s course right .

The enormous challenge of restoring glory to Old Trafford

The English club has placed a strong bet on Pochettino's ability to develop young talents and forge high-performance squads, qualities that the board considers essential to compete at the highest level both in the Premier League and in European competitions. The urgency at Old Trafford is absolute after an inconsistent start to the season that accelerated the changes in the technical leadership.

With his arrival, United fans hope to witness that hallmark brand of attacking, high-intensity football that has accompanied the coach throughout his career in England. The challenge is no small one, but the Argentine tactician has proven to be accustomed to taking on the most demanding challenges under the intense scrutiny of the British media .

Meanwhile, the United States Federation is already working against the clock in the search for a guaranteed replacement to continue the project started by the Argentine, aware that the upcoming international commitments leave no respite. The Pochettino era in North America has come to an end, but his indelible mark on the region's football will remain intact .

articles.title: Pochettino's Manchester United prepares €80 million to snatch a gem from Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: The English side is looking to pull off a masterstroke in the European market under the guidance of its new Argentine strategist
articles.summary: The English side is looking to pull off a masterstroke in the European market under the guidance of its new Argentine strategist
articles.body:
Mauricio Pochettino has officially taken over as head coach of Manchester United , bringing his time in charge of the United States national team to an end after an agreement that included the payment of his release clause. The coach from Santa Fe arrives at Old Trafford with the monumental task of getting a sleeping giant back on track, one that is going through one of the most turbulent periods in its recent history in the English league.

Given this landscape of profound sporting restructuring, the Red Devils' board is already working ahead of the upcoming transfer windows with the aim of refreshing the squad and surrounding its stars with game-changing talent . Competitive urgency demands bold moves and short- and long-term planning to return the club to the top of the continent.

Amid this rebuilding scenario, various journalistic reports from outlets such as Clarín and Infobae have begun to strongly link one of the top emerging stars of the Argentina National Team with the Mancunian bench , generating great anticipation within the international football scene.

A Champions League executioner who captivates Old Trafford

The protagonist of these rumors is Nico Paz , the talented attacking midfielder who is shining brightly for Como in Italy's Serie A under the guidance of Cesc Fàbregas . Reports published by outlets such as Radio Mitre and Urgente24 detail that Manchester United's interest intensified notably after the young midfielder's display in Europe's top club competition .

Just a few weeks ago, in a match corresponding to the UEFA Champions League group stage, the skillful left-footer delivered a memorable performance by scoring a brace in the Italian side's emphatic 4-1 thrashing of Manchester United itself . That display of talent left the English club's executives and coaching staff open-mouthed, and they now see him as the ideal heir and generational replacement for Bruno Fernandes.

Real Madrid's shadow and the financial battle

However, the operation does not appear feasible due to the complex contractual web linking the footballer to Real Madrid . As analyses from the international press and specialized outlets have pointed out, the Merengue club reserved a buyback option set at 80 million euros , which can only be exercised within a strict period during the summer transfer window, specifically between July 1 and 15, 2027.

It should be remembered that the White House already tried to bring back its former prospect last summer at the express request of José Mourinho, but the player himself chose to prioritize staying in Italy in order to consolidate his leading role . In addition, Como made a historic financial effort of close to 60 million euros to acquire 100% of his rights, considerably raising the bar for any club interested in his transfer.

Pochettino's trump card and the English raid plan

Aware of these obstacles, Manchester United would be willing to put a figure close to or above 80 million euros on the table to get ahead of any move by Real Madrid and secure the signing before the Los Blancos clause comes into effect. The presence of Mauricio Pochettino as a fellow countryman and the man ultimately in charge of the sporting project stands out as a key factor in enticing the player.

While Bruno Fernandes' future continues to raise questions amid the lack of an agreement over his contract renewal, Manchester United are accelerating their institutional machinery . The possibility of a change of scenery to the Premier League appeals to the player's camp, although the final outcome will depend both on Como's stance and on the intentions of the Madrid side .

The transfer market promises high drama and the name of the young Argentine gem will continue to dominate headlines as Europe’s giants battle to secure his services. The fight for the marquee signing is officially underway.

articles.title: Harry Kane stuns NFL fans with insane 68-yard field goal
articles.summary: Harry Kane is used to making headlines for scoring spectacular goals, but the Bayern Munich superstar has found a completely different way to surprise sports fans: kicking a football through the uprights from an astonishing distance. A video shared by the Bundesliga has sparked a social media frenzy after showing the England international attempting an NFL-style field goal from 68 yards. The clip immediately caught the attention of football fans on both sides of the Atlantic, with some wondering whether the footage was generated using artificial intelligence and others convinced that Kane genuinely has the leg strength to compete with professional NFL kickers. The spectacle is particularly interesting because Kane’s fascination with American football is no secret. The Bayern striker has repeatedly expressed admiration for the NFL, has previously demonstrated his ability to kick long-distance field goals and has even discussed the possibility of becoming a professional kicker after retiring from soccer.

articles.title: One awkward hug, plenty of questions: USMNT fans react to Pochettino and Pulisic video
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino’s final days as head coach of the United States men’s national team have brought an unexpected talking point: his brief, seemingly awkward interaction with Christian Pulisic during a training session. A video recorded Friday at the U.S. Soccer training center in Fayetteville, Georgia, began circulating on social media, prompting fans to question whether there is tension between the outgoing manager and the team’s biggest attacking star. In the footage, Pochettino moves through the line of players, greeting several with warm embraces. When he reaches Pulisic, however, the exchange appears noticeably shorter. The AC Milan forward offers a one-armed hug, and the two quickly move on. The contrast was enough to get USMNT supporters talking.

articles.title: Mexico vs. Jamaica: El Tri exposes its weaknesses in costly defeat
articles.standfirst: Mexico endured a night to forget in Kingston and will now have to find answers on home soil.
articles.summary: Mexico endured a night to forget in Kingston and will now have to find answers on home soil.
articles.body:
Mexico's national team is still far from delivering the excitement and confidence it inspired during the World Cup. Saturday's match against Jamaica, November 14, made that clear once again . Rafael Márquez's side made costly mistakes that left it chasing the game and ultimately struggling to recover from a match that slipped out of its hands.

The first leg of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinals took place at the National Stadium in Kingston and marked Márquez's first official match in charge of El Tri after four friendlies.

Jamaica capitalizes on Mexico's mistakes and puts El Tri on the ropes

Mexico had its moments going forward and managed to threaten the opposing goal, but trying to take control of a match is one thing; turning that pressure into goals is another. Julián Quiñones had one of Mexico's clearest chances to take the lead, but he was unable to beat the Jamaican goalkeeper .

The lack of finishing became even more costly once the defensive mistakes began. In the 27th minute, a corner kick ended with Jesús Gallardo deflecting the ball into his own net . The own goal gave Jamaica the lead and left Mexico searching for an answer that never came before halftime.

The second half brought no relief. Just one minute after the restart, in the 46th minute, Renaldo Cephas got past Israel Reyes and beat Raúl Rangel to make it 2-0 . Mexico had no answer for Jamaica's attacks, and before the visitors could regroup, they were dealt another blow.

In the 59th minute, the referee went to VAR to review a foul by Gallardo inside the box and awarded a penalty. Richard King stepped up in the 63rd minute and converted to make it 3-0 . Within minutes, Mexico had gone from facing a difficult challenge to fighting for survival.

Gilberto Mora and Julián Quiñones spark Mexico's comeback when it seemed too late

With a three-goal deficit to overcome, Márquez turned to his bench in search of a change. Alexis Vega, Jesús Corona and Santiago Sandoval came on to give Mexico's attack a different look, and the team finally found the response it had been missing.

Gilberto Mora was the first to step up . In the 70th minute, the young midfielder fired a low shot from outside the box and found the back of the net, giving El Tri a much-needed glimmer of hope.

The comeback gained momentum 11 minutes later. After a foul on Sandoval inside the penalty area, Mexico was awarded a spot kick, which Julián Quiñones converted to make it 3-2. What had looked like a blowout suddenly became a much tighter contest , with Mexico pushing for an equalizer that ultimately never came.

Those two goals changed the complexion of the tie and prevented Mexico from returning home facing an even bigger deficit. Still, they also left a difficult question hanging over the team: why did it take being backed into a corner to find the finishing touch that had been missing for most of the night?

Mexico faces Jamaica again in Monterrey with a comeback on the line

The tie is far from over. The second leg will take place on Tuesday, November 17, at Estadio BBVA in Monterrey, Nuevo León , where El Tri will have a chance to turn the series around and secure a place in the Concacaf Nations League semifinals.

But Mexico cannot rely on another late surge. The team will need to show a much more solid version of itself, particularly on defense, while making the most of its scoring opportunities from the opening whistle. The one-goal difference keeps the tie alive, but Jamaica has already shown just how much damage it can do.
